posts.title: 112 UX Memes: Usability Misery Loves Company
posts.description: A good interface lets you get on with your life. A bad one gives you a war story. These 112 usability memes commemorate the battles we never wanted to fight. Count how many you’ve lived through, and share your favorites with someone who understands.

posts.title: What UX Tasks Will AI Be Able to Do, and When?
posts.description: AI masters UX tasks in order of how cheaply their results can be verified. Hard-to-verify work improves just as fast as easy work; it simply starts later. By 2030, AI will beat humans at every UX task with a checkable result, leaving people two jobs: deciding what’s worth doing and aligning the team.
